body:
See GitHub README: https://github.com/szkele1145/sablefix

Install the SAME jar on both server and client.

In-game: /sfxpanel opens the GUI panel. Server commands: /sablefix check|list|tickets|dump|help.

Passive features: startup sub-level/ticket check (read-only), auto full thread dump when main thread stalls 20s (vanilla kills at 60s), run log.

Feedback / Feedback: QQ 1129543042 (CN) · Telegram @maodie_mods (intl, see v1.1.0 changelog & in-mod About tab)

v1.1.0: bilingual UI (en_us/zh_cn), Telegram in mod About tab, 7 bugfixes, panel permission check, UI modularized.
